name: Composer

test_list.description: Preparing and cancelling or rejecting admission preserves text, cursor and chips; commit clears only the matching unchanged draft.
A candidate prepared before a later draft edit returns a typed stale error and preserves the edited draft.
Undo and prompt history are bounded by count and retained bytes, evicting oldest snapshots.
Undo snapshots share Arc-backed paste payloads rather than copying payload bytes.
A blank submission is rejected without changing the draft.
Generated text/chip sequences expand exactly into the submitted text.
Cursor movement remains on valid UTF-8/grapheme boundaries.

inputs.name: prepared
inputs.description: Opaque snapshot tied to current draft revision.

output_description: Non-mutating prepared candidate, or committed submission; stale/empty/size errors preserve the draft.
